# D199 — Continue delivery through the Claude session limit

Actual Fable5.2/xhigh review and actual Opus5.5/xhigh QA for #486 both ended with exit1, first-party429 usage_limit_reached, reporting reset at10:00AM America/Chicago on November21. Their result envelopes say subtype success but is_error=true and terminal_reason=api_error; they are neither successful worker completions nor verdicts. Fable sessiona0c70fbc-3dfc-4556-92ab-a64d61f0897e and Opus sessiondf484ec2-47c6-45c6-822c-ca13fe061be3 are retained exactly. Formal general slot1 remains unfinished, not approved; no new general scan is created merely to continue the same frozen-source review.

Select active-chat persistence until the reported reset,16:00UTC. Preserve complete provider records, a hashed pre-limit QA snapshot, source633d9ac72c10fe4b8d76f7ba50221f9ed8557cb9 and the planned verification matrix. The runner intentionally disables session persistence, so continuation uses a fresh provider envelope with explicit original transcripts, source binding and unfinished-work handoff; it does not pretend to resume a saved CLI session. Retain original partial work and every error rather than overwriting them. Resume the same required model/effort roles after the reset and verify genuine successful envelopes before accepting any verdict.

Continue authorized independent GPT QA, current-main integration, archive preparation and gate bookkeeping while waiting. Respect the four-worker cap at the moment of resumed dispatch. Do not start new Claude requests before the reset, substitute a model family, enable paid overages, treat partial analysis as approval, waive technical gates or end delivery merely because quota is temporarily unavailable. Use an in-turn UTC deadline guard and continue this chat; do not create a recurring app automation for this one delivery job. If quota remains unavailable after the reset, retain that exact new response and follow its reported limit with a bounded later continuation, not a hot loop.

Decline stopping for the user to restart the chat, spending paid overages without authorization, replacing required opposite-family review with GPT, or calling an error envelope successful because one field says success. This is a resource/scheduling disposition under delegated blocker authority, with no product or coverage exception. The decision catalogue will preserve the reset, attempts, completed continuation outcomes and any residual gaps for final owner review.
